# Roman Concrete Research by David Moore

> > Comprehensive research on ancient Roman concrete technology, focusing on the Pantheon's construction and its relevance to modern engineering.

David Moore, a Stanford-educated engineer and US Navy Seabee veteran, presents original research on Roman concrete construction techniques, particularly the Pantheon's innovative use of pozzolan-based concrete. The site bridges ancient construction methods with modern applications including roller-compacted concrete and dam engineering.

## Key Topics

- Roman Pantheon
- Roman concrete
- David Moore
- pozzolan
- ancient construction techniques
- Hadrian
- concrete history
- Hoover Dam

- bamboo reinforcement
- The Roman Pantheon: The Triumph of Concrete
